payload.title: Review follow-ups: scale, consolidate, gate, front door (2026-10-17)
payload.description: Work items from the full review of Cyclotron and Cyclotron-web delivered 2026-10-17. Review doc: https://claude.ai/code/artifact/dcd5a089-28f1-4a3f-9f2f-a293789709c0 (Cyclotron review, 2026-10-17). Each child issue is one PR-sized change with its own definition of done; the review doc has the file:line evidence. Priority 0 items carry the headline metric and the scaling ceiling; priority 1 items are the gate and the front door; priority 2 items are consolidation. The two open bugs from the 1,200-cycle study (reader lock fails the writer after five seconds; replay resume re-records a cycle) are already filed and belong with this epic's scaling work. Standing rule: CI for private repos runs locally (no GitHub Actions minutes). Run the full gate locally before merging.
